s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection
salient_findings: Eroded, crusted papule on the left forehead
Granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts
key_facts: Presented with a tender nodule on her forehead
History of bumping her forehead on an air-conditioning unit several months prior
Denied fever, neck stiffness, and photophobia
Lived alone with a pet cat and spent minimal time outdoors
No recent exposure to systemic steroids
Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts

shortlist.label: Cryptococcosis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts and tissue culture grew Cryptococcus neoformans

shortlist.label: Sporotrichosis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation, consistent with sporotrichosis presentation

shortlist.label: Histoplasmosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection, although less common, histoplasmosis can cause similar symptoms

shortlist.label: Phaeohyphomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute presentation and granulomatous inflammation, phaeohyphomycosis is a rare but possible diagnosis

shortlist.label: Blastomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection, blastomycosis can cause similar symptoms, although less likely

shortlist.label: Chromoblastomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute presentation and granulomatous inflammation, chromoblastomycosis is a rare but possible diagnosis

shortlist.label: Actinomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation, although actinomycosis typically presents with different symptoms, it cannot be entirely ruled out

shortlist.label: Nocardiosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and immunocompromised state due to fingolimod treatment, nocardiosis is a rare but possible diagnosis

raw.rationale: The skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts with thick capsules, and tissue culture grew Cryptococcus neoformans, which is a definitive evidence for Cryptococcosis. The patient's immunocompromised state due to multiple sclerosis treatment with fingolimod also increases the risk of opportunistic infections like Cryptococcosis.

rejected.label: Sporotrichosis
rejected.why: Sporotrichosis typically presents with a history of trauma and exposure to soil or plants, which is not mentioned in the case. The skin biopsy and culture results do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Histoplasmosis
rejected.why: Histoplasmosis is typically associated with exposure to bird or bat droppings, and the skin biopsy and culture results do not support this diagnosis.
